Name: Critter Rings
Author: atravita
Description:
This incredibly self-indulgent mod has five rings in it: the Butterfly Ring, the Bunny Ring, the Frog Ring, the Owl Ring, and the Firefly Ring. Each summons the relevant critter when worn. Additionally, each has extra secondary effect. Frog jumps, bunny ring has a sprint, the owl ring makes it so enemies are less likely to see you, firefly is a glowstone ring, and butterfly is a magnetic ring.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download and unzip [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]Spacecore[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url], and unzip both into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12932]AtraCore[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Rings[/size]
[list]
[*][b]Bunny Ring[/b]: Allows a 14s "sprint" of +3 (configurable) speed in return for 10 (configurable) stamina. Summons bunnies. Buy from Marlon after receiving the Skull Key and the Magic Ink.
[*][b]Butterfly Ring[/b]: Acts as magnet ring, summons butterflies before dark. Buy from Marlon after receiving the Skull Key.
[*][b]Firefly Ring[/b]: Acts as a glow ring, summons fireflies after dark. Buy from Marlon after receiving the Skull Key.
[*][b]Frog Ring[/b]: Hold down the jump button to charge up a jump! Costs stamina, though. Buy from Marlon after receiving the Skull Key and the Magic Ink.
[*][b]Owl Ring[/b]: Makes enemies less likely to see you. Summons owls. Buy from Marlon after receiving the Skull Key and the Magic Ink.
[/list]
[size=5]Configuration[/size]
Run SMAPI at least once with this mod installed to generate the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font], or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to configure.

[size=4]General Options:[/size]
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]CritterSpawnMultiplier[/font]: Controls how many critters will spawn per interval of time. Set it higher to get more critters.
[*][font=Courier New]PlayAudioEffects[/font]: Whether or not the audio effects from this mod will be played.
[/list]
[size=4]Butterfly Ring Options[/size]
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]ButterfliesSpawnInRain[/font]: if enabled, butterflies will spawn in the rain.
[/list]
[size=4]Bunny Ring Options.[/size]
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]BunnyRingStamina[/font]: How much stamina each sprint of the bunny ring should take.
[*][font=Courier New]BunnyRingBoost[/font]: Indicates how much speed the bunny ring sprint should add. Default +3.
[*][font=Courier New]BunnyRingButton[/font]: Indicates which button(s) to use for the bunny ring's sprint.
[/list]
[size=4]Frog Ring Options[/size]
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]MaxFrogJumpDistance[/font]: Maximum distance the frog ring will jump you.
[*][font=Courier New]FrogRingButton[/font]: The button used for the frog jump.
[*][font=Courier New]JumpChargeSpeed[/font]: Indicates how quickly the jump should charge up. Higher for faster.
[*][font=Courier New]JumpCostsStamina[/font]: Whether or not the jump should cost stamina. If enabled, it will cost one stamina point per square moved.
[*][font=Courier New]ViewportFollowsTarget[/font]: If enabled, the viewport will try to follow the midpoint between the target and the player character.
[*] [font=Courier New]FrogsSpawnInHeat[/font]: If enabled, frogs will spawn in places probably too hot for them, like the volcano.
[*][font=Courier New]FrogsSpawnInCold[/font]: If enabled, frogs will spawn in places probably too cold for them, like during winter or in the ice levels of the mines.
[*][font=Courier New]FrogsSpawnOnlyInRain[/font]: If enabled, frogs will only spawn outdoors when it's raining.
[*][font=Courier New]SaltwaterFrogs[/font]: If enabled, frogs might spawn in saltwater.
[*][font=Courier New]IndoorFrogs[/font]: If enabled, frogs might spawn indoors.
[/list]
[size=4]Owl Ring Options[/size]
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]OwlsSpawnIndoors[/font]: If enabled, owls will spawn indoors.
[*][font=Courier New]OwlsSpawnDuringDay[/font]: If enabled, owls will spawn during the day.
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode. In multiplayer, both players should install.
[*]Should be compatible with most other mods.
[/list]
[size=5]Much thanks to[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/120958053]Violetlizabet[/url] for drawing the ring graphics for me! Check out her [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10142]Magic Furniture[/url]﻿ mod!
[/list]
[size=5]Other mods in gifs[/size]
The outfit in the big tree gif is, of course, from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]. I'm quite impressed that not a pixel is out of place, even with frog jump's custom animations. PeacefulEnd did an excellent job with that mod. Go get it.

Hair is from Lady [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10294]Shardust[/url], clothing is mostly from[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11113] Wabi's wardrobe[/url], headpiece is from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11757]Chinese Wedding Dress[/url], and the pack is from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10211]Backpacks and Baubles[/url].

Additionally, the white corset is from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11446]Bridal Boutique[/url].
